env.wlanssid: SSID of the home router's 2.4 GHz network (value kept outside Git)
env.wlanpass: passphrase of that network (value kept outside Git)
env.how: fw_setenv over SSH with the values on stdin; read back with fw_printenv

camera_changes.runtime_only: trial script, trial wpa_supplicant config, trial log and keep flag under /tmp (tmpfs, gone after the reboot)

mechanism.to_change_network: set wlanssid and wlanpass, then reboot

network.before: host AP on the Linux host's Wi-Fi (NetworkManager profile openipc-final-host-ap on wlp1s0); NTP did not reach the camera
network.after: home router (Aterm), 2.4 GHz, channel 11 (2.462 GHz), DHCP lease 86400 s; router settings untouched

host.why_wifi: the host's wired LAN (default route) is on a different subnet from the router's Wi-Fi; the camera was not found from the wired side
host.wlp1s0: client of the router's 2.4 GHz (NetworkManager profile iermu-home-uplink: static IPv4, never the default route, IPv6 off)
host.host_ap: openipc-final-host-ap deactivated; profile kept with autoconnect off

procedure: record the camera's SSH ed25519 host key
trial without flash writes: wifi/wifi-switch-trial.sh with a 300 s window (wlan_conf output for the router under /tmp)
switch the host's Wi-Fi from the AP to the router and find the camera by its host key (wifi/find-by-hostkey.sh), then create the keep flag
fw_setenv wlanssid/wlanpass, read back, check that wlan_conf from the new env equals the trial config, reboot

trial.script: wifi/wifi-switch-trial.sh (same logic as the copy that ran; the repository copy adds comments, neutral /tmp file names and overrides for the tests)
trial.joined_note: from the script's start line to the DHCP lease, including its own sleeps and the wait for the old wpa_supplicant to exit
trial.discovery: not found from the wired LAN; found by its SSH ed25519 host key on the host's Wi-Fi after the host joined the router

vicheck: VI configured but no frame (cold start); restarting majestic once
video input running after one restart
reboot.kernel_log: NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0 (hieth): transmit queue 0 timed out (eth0 has no PHY on this board; not investigated)

outbound: no outbound TCP connections in 4 samples 13 min after the reboot; ntpd uses pool.ntp.org

revert.to_host_ap: while the camera is on the router: fw_setenv wlanssid/wlanpass back to the host AP values (kept outside Git), reboot, then bring up openipc-final-host-ap on the host within about 30 s
revert.trial_only: wifi/wifi-switch-trial.sh without the keep flag returns to the env network

offline_tests.shell: host BusyBox ash with stub network tools

open_issues: the DHCP address is not reserved on the router (router settings untouched); find-by-hostkey.sh finds the camera if it changes
2.4 GHz only: if the router's 2.4 GHz SSID or passphrase changes, or 2.4 GHz is switched off, the camera cannot join; recover with a temporary AP that uses the camera's current SSID and passphrase
the camera can now reach the internet (needed for NTP); no ports opened on the router; /metrics stays readable without a password on the home network
long-term link stability (overnight) not yet observed
kept_outside_git: previous host AP SSID and passphrase
